freeware.release_notes: v1.2.0: Freeware relaunch — new Home dashboard lands first (today's calendar, due tasks, storage health, module launchpad). VERA Chat can now act on your machine: ask about storage, disk cleanup, calendar, tasks, and updates and it answers with real data from your device, not guesses. All workspace modules are included free: Quick Organizer, Team Lab, Guardian Watch, ProMailer, Research Lab. Intel Mac .dmg restored via vendored-openssl build fix.

pro.release_notes: Rotated license public key, fixed Windows compilation, updated modules signatures, and released new installers.
